channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Plans put forward to build 80-bed care home and 15 new houses
item.description: Plans for an 80-bed care home and new 15 new houses have been unveiled in Gosport.

item.title: Two men jailed for almost nine years after New Forest crime spree
item.description: Two men have been jailed for a total of almost nine years for a brazen hour-long crime spree in the New Forest, Hampshire.

item.title: Application submitted to see Ringwood NatWest building turned into new homes
item.description: Plans have been submitted to convert a former NatWest bank in Ringwood town centre into new homes.

item.title: Councillor tells of 'aggressive' abuse at hands of angry Southampton residents
item.description: A Southampton councillor has described how abuse and online harassment are affecting her safety, mental health and ability to work with the community.

item.title: Man arrested for crime in town he never visited after facial recognition blunder
item.description: A man who spent nearly ten hours in police custody after facial recognition technology falsely linked him to a crime committed more than 100 miles away says basic detective work was not carried out.

item.title: Bakery and cafe owner disputes 1 out of 5 hygiene rating
item.description: Phoenix Bakery and Cafe Gosport has been told major improvements are needed to food safety after receiving a one out of five food hygiene rating

item.title: Everything we know as plane crashes in to beach at Lee-on-the-Solent
item.description: A pilot had a miraculous escape after an aircraft crashed onto the beach at Lee-on-the-Solent on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: New application submitted for six homes at Pear Tree pub after refusal
item.description: Plans to build six new homes next a pub in Boorley Green have been resubmitted following a previously dismissed appeal.

item.title: Man attacked by neighbour felt like a 'beaten dog' after unprovoked attack
item.description: A man who attacked his neighbour, making him feel like a "frightened beaten dog" has been sentenced at court

item.title: Landlords fined for harassing tenant to get out of property
item.description: Two landlords barged into a tenant's home to harass him into leaving after he reported them to the council and hadn't paid rent
